nodes.description: IERC20 private _token: ERC20 token contract whose balances are held by the timelock.
address private _beneficiary: recipient of the tokens once the release time is reached.
uint256 private _releaseTime: unix timestamp gating when tokens may be released.
TokenTimelock constructor: validates releaseTime > block.timestamp and stores token, beneficiary and releaseTime.
token(): view getter returning the held IERC20 token.
beneficiary(): view getter returning the beneficiary address.
releaseTime(): view getter returning the release timestamp.
release(): checks block.timestamp >= _releaseTime, reads the contract token balance and transfers it to the beneficiary.
CATXTimeLock constructor: forwards token, beneficiary and releaseTime to the TokenTimelock base constructor.
block.timestamp used as the time source for the release gate in both the base constructor and release().
_token.safeTransfer(_beneficiary, amount): external token call that hands control to an untrusted token contract and moves the whole held balance.
IERC20 token parameter of the TokenTimelock constructor, assigned to _token.
address beneficiary parameter of the TokenTimelock constructor, assigned to _beneficiary.
uint256 releaseTime parameter of the TokenTimelock constructor, assigned to _releaseTime after a block.timestamp check.
address token parameter of the CATXTimeLock constructor, cast to IERC20 and passed to the base constructor.
address beneficiary parameter of the CATXTimeLock constructor, forwarded to the base constructor.
uint256 releaseTime parameter of the CATXTimeLock constructor, forwarded to the base constructor.
uint256 amount local in release(): balance of this contract in the held token, transferred to the beneficiary.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token is stored into the _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary is stored into the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter releaseTime is stored into the _releaseTime state variable.
Constructor requires releaseTime > block.timestamp, making deployment validity and constructor control flow dependent on the timestamp.
release() gates execution on require(block.timestamp >= _releaseTime); the unlock condition depends on the miner-controlled timestamp.
release() reads _releaseTime to evaluate the time gate.
release() builds the amount and invokes the external safeTransfer, forwarding control to the untrusted token contract.
The stored _token contract is the target of the safeTransfer external call.
The stored _beneficiary address is the recipient argument of safeTransfer.
The local amount (contract token balance) is the value argument of safeTransfer.
The externally called token contract can re-enter release() during safeTransfer before any state is finalized.
The CATXTimeLock constructor invokes the TokenTimelock base constructor via inheritance.
CATXTimeLock constructor token parameter is converted to IERC20 and used by the base constructor call.
CATXTimeLock constructor beneficiary parameter is forwarded through the base constructor call.
CATXTimeLock constructor releaseTime parameter is forwarded through the base constructor call.
